verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.

xrefs.text: These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel,
A rod of correction imparts wisdom, but a child left to himself disgraces his mother.
A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to her who bore him.
My son, if your heart is wise, my own heart will indeed rejoice.
A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

verses.text: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.

xrefs.text: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
There is life in the path of righteousness, but another path leads to death.
Making a fortune by a lying tongue is a vanishing mist, a deadly pursuit.
They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.

They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will seem unclean. Their silver and gold cannot save them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their appetites or fill their stomachs with wealth, for it became the stumbling block that brought their iniquity.

verses.text: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.

xrefs.text: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

verses.text: Idle hands make one poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.

xrefs.text: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and an idle soul will suffer hunger.
The slacker does not plow in season; at harvest time he looks, but nothing is there.
The slacker craves yet has nothing, but the soul of the diligent is fully satisfied.
The plans of the diligent bring plenty, as surely as haste leads to poverty.
The hand of the diligent will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.

verses.text: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.

xrefs.text: it prepares its provisions in summer; it gathers its food at harvest.
The ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;
A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son and share his inheritance as one of the brothers.
Walk in the manner of the ant, O slacker; observe its ways and become wise.
He who assaults his father or evicts his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.

verses.text: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

xrefs.text: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God:
A faithful man will abound with blessings, but one eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
The dying man blessed me, and I made the widow’s heart sing for joy.
but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come upon them.

verses.text: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.

xrefs.text: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
For He has looked with favor on the humble state of His servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed.
And truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.
May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
And Jehoiada was buried with the kings in the City of David, because he had done what was good in Israel for God and His temple.

verses.text: A wise heart will receive commandments, but foolish lips will come to ruin.

xrefs.text: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.
Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
Instruct a wise man, and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man, and he will increase his learning.

verses.text: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

xrefs.text: He who walks with integrity will be kept safe, but whoever is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall.
But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.

He who walks righteously and speaks with sincerity, who refuses gain from extortion, whose hand never takes a bribe, who stops his ears against murderous plots and shuts his eyes tightly against evil—

Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men’s hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.

verses.text: He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin.

xrefs.text: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
winking his eyes, speaking with his feet, and pointing with his fingers.
A wise heart will receive commandments, but foolish lips will come to ruin.

So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.
Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

verses.text: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

xrefs.text: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning one from the snares of death.
Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.
The words of a man’s mouth are deep waters; the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.
Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

verses.text: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers all transgressions.

xrefs.text: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
Whoever conceals an offense promotes love, but he who brings it up separates friends.
A hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but he who is slow to anger calms dispute.
consider this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.

verses.text: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.

xrefs.text: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!
He who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.
The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.
Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.

verses.text: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of the fool invites destruction.

xrefs.text: A fool’s mouth is his ruin, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
A wise heart will receive commandments, but foolish lips will come to ruin.
He who guards his mouth protects his life, but the one who opens his lips invites his own ruin.
He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin.
Instruct a wise man, and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man, and he will increase his learning.

verses.text: The wealth of the rich man is his fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.

xrefs.text: A rich man’s wealth is his fortified city; it is like a high wall in his imagination.
All the brothers of a poor man hate him— how much more do his friends avoid him! He may pursue them with pleading, but they are nowhere to be found.
The poor man is hated even by his neighbor, but many are those who love the rich.
“Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”
Do not rob a poor man because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate,

verses.text: The labor of the righteous leads to life, but the gain of the wicked brings punishment.

xrefs.text: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.
Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.
Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

verses.text: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who ignores reproof goes astray.

xrefs.text: Discipline is harsh for him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.
But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.
and you will say, “How I hated discipline, and my heart despised reproof!
For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
For this commandment is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life,

verses.text: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.

xrefs.text: A hateful man disguises himself with his speech, but he lays up deceit in his heart.
His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.

When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab pulled him aside into the gateway, as if to speak to him privately, and there Joab stabbed him in the stomach. So Abner died on account of the blood of Joab’s brother Asahel.
who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend,
Two years later, when Absalom’s sheepshearers were at Baal-hazor near Ephraim, he invited all the sons of the king.

verses.text: When words are many, sin is unavoidable, but he who restrains his lips is wise.

xrefs.text: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
A man of knowledge restrains his words, and a man of understanding maintains a calm spirit.
We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
The beginning of his talk is folly, and the end of his speech is evil madness.
As a dream comes through many cares, so the speech of a fool comes with many words.

verses.text: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.

xrefs.text: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.
You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.
A soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.

verses.text: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of judgment.

xrefs.text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you as My priests. Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children.
Why should the fool have money in his hand with no intention of buying wisdom?
When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD.
Surely you have instructed many, and have strengthened their feeble hands.

verses.text: The blessing of the LORD enriches, and He adds no sorrow to it.

xrefs.text: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
Now Isaac sowed seed in the land, and that very year he reaped a hundredfold. And the LORD blessed him,
The LORD sends poverty and wealth; He humbles and He exalts.
“The LORD has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.
I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.

verses.text: The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.

xrefs.text: Folly is joy to one who lacks judgment, but a man of understanding walks a straight path.
Fools mock the making of amends, but goodwill is found among the upright.
from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil,
Like a madman shooting firebrands and deadly arrows,

Rejoice, O young man, while you are young, and let your heart be glad in the days of your youth. Walk in the ways of your heart and in the sight of your eyes, but know that for all these things God will bring you to judgment.

verses.text: What the wicked man dreads will overtake him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

xrefs.text: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.

So I will choose their punishment and I will bring terror upon them, because I called and no one answered, I spoke and no one listened. But they did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.”
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
Sounds of terror fill his ears; in his prosperity the destroyer attacks him.
And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

verses.text: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are secure forever.

xrefs.text: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.
A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.
Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
Before your pots can feel the burning thorns— whether green or dry— He will sweep them away.
when your dread comes like a storm, and your destruction like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish overwhelm you.

verses.text: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the slacker to those who send him.

xrefs.text: Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest is a trustworthy messenger to those who send him; he refreshes the soul of his masters.
‘You wicked, lazy servant! replied his master. ‘You knew that I reap where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed.
Like cutting off one’s own feet or drinking violence is the sending of a message by the hand of a fool.
Like one who removes a garment on a cold day or vinegar poured on a wound is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.

verses.text: The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.

xrefs.text: For through wisdom your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.
for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
It will be paid in full before his time, and his branch will not flourish.
Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

verses.text: The hope of the righteous is joy, but the expectations of the wicked will perish.

xrefs.text: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
When the wicked man dies, his hope perishes, and the hope of his strength vanishes.
But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will elude them; they will hope for their last breath.”

verses.text: The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright, but destruction awaits those who do evil.

xrefs.text: Justice executed is a joy to the righteous, but a terror to the workers of iniquity.
But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow wickedness, there will be wrath and anger.
I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
I will strengthen them in the LORD, and in His name they will walk,” declares the LORD.

verses.text: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not inhabit the land.

xrefs.text: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

verses.text: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.

xrefs.text: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.
The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.
May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.

verses.text: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

xrefs.text: By the blessing of the upright a city is built up, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked blurts out evil.
